mapper.select: INSERT INTO chat_session (user_id, title) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}) RETURNING id

WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, role, content, sources) SELECT s.id, #{role}, #{content}, CAST(#{sources} AS jsonb) FROM chat_session s WHERE s.id = #{sessionId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} RETURNING id, session_id, role, content, sources, created_at ), touched AS ( UPDATE chat_session s SET updated_at = GREATEST(s.updated_at, clock_timestamp()) FROM inserted i WHERE s.id = i.session_id RETURNING s.id ) SELECT i.id, i.session_id, i.role, i.content, i.sources, i.created_at FROM inserted i JOIN touched t ON t.id = i.session_id

WITH finalized AS ( UPDATE chat_message m SET content = #{content}, sources = CAST(#{sources} AS jsonb) FROM chat_session s WHERE m.id = #{messageId} AND m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND s.id = m.session_id AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND m.role = 'ASSISTANT' AND m.content = '' RETURNING m.id, m.session_id, m.role, m.content, m.sources, m.created_at ), touched AS ( UPDATE chat_session s SET updated_at = GREATEST(s.updated_at, clock_timestamp()) FROM finalized f WHERE s.id = f.session_id RETURNING s.id ) SELECT f.id, f.session_id, f.role, f.content, f.sources, f.created_at FROM finalized f JOIN touched t ON t.id = f.session_id

WITH stale AS ( SELECT m.id FROM chat_message m WHERE m.role = 'ASSISTANT' AND m.content = '' AND m.created_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), deleted AS ( DELETE FROM chat_message m USING stale WHERE m.id = stale.id RETURNING m.id ) SELECT count(*) FROM deleted

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.created_at, s.updated_at, last_message.content AS last_message FROM chat_session s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.content FROM chat_message m WHERE m.session_id = s.id AND NOT (m.role = 'ASSISTANT' AND m.content = '') ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) last_message ON true WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
